y-m-05-08.title: Ndiani mukuru, 98cm kana 1m 5cm?
y-m-05-08.topic: Hurefu hwakanyorwa nem ne cm pamwe chete
y-m-05-08.goal: Nzwisisa kuti kuenzanisa hurefu hwezvikamu zvakasiyana nekutarisa nhamba chete kunopa mhinduro isina kururama. Enzanisa nekushandura kuita chikamu chimwe chete, uye utsanangure kumunin'ina nemashoko akapfava.
y-m-05-08.material: 1m ndi100cm. Kana kukwira kwakanyorwa se 1m 5cm, ihurefu hwe 1m ne 5cm pamwe chete. Kukwira kwaSua ndi1m 5cm, uye kukwira kwaJiho ndi98cm. Kuti aone kuti ndiani mukuru, Ido akagadzirisa seizvi pazasi.
y-m-05-08.thinking.1: Kushandura pakati pe m ne cm kugadzira hurefu hunosangana nemamiriro
y-m-05-08.prereq.1: Kuverenga nekunyora hurefu uchishandisa cm ne m pamwe chete
y-m-05-08.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mumhinduro yaIdo apo kukwira kwakatanga kuenzaniswa zvisina kururama. (Mitsara yakanamatirwa nhamba kubva ku1.)
y-m-05-08.s.s1.hint.0: Mumitsara iri nemashoko ekuenzanisa kukwira, tarisa kuti zvikamu zvakanamatirwa mushure menhamba dzakaenzaniswa zvakafanana here.
y-m-05-08.s.s1.hint.1: Isa 1m 5cm ne98cm muchikamu chimwe chete uye uzvienzanise nemhedziso yaIdo.
y-m-05-08.s.s1.line.0: Kukwira kwaSua ndi1m 5cm, uye kukwira kwaJiho ndi98cm.
y-m-05-08.s.s1.line.1: 1m 5cm ihurefu hwe 1m ne 5cm zvakawedzerwa pamwe chete, uye 98cm yaJiho ihurefu hwe98cm.
y-m-05-08.s.s1.line.2: 98 yakakura kupfuura 1 kana 5, saka kukwira kwaJiho kukuru.
y-m-05-08.s.s1.explain: Inotanga kuenzanisa zvisina kururama mumutsara 3. 1 ndi m, 5 ndi cm, uye 98 ndi cm, saka nhamba dzine zvikamu zvakasiyana hadzigoni kuenzaniswa sezvazviri. 1m 5cm ndi105cm, iyo yakareba kupfuura 98cm. Mhedziso yemutsara 4 inobva pakuenzanisa kusina kururama kwemutsara 3, saka ikukanganisa kunotevera shure.
y-m-05-08.s.s2.prompt: Nyora hurefu hutatu hwakasiyana, se 'm m cm', hurefu hukuru kupfuura hwaSua (1m 5cm) uye hupfupi kupfuura 1m 20cm. (m inhamba yechisikwa i0 kana kupfuura, uye cm inhamba yechisikwa kubva ku0 kusvika ku99.)
y-m-05-08.s.s2.hint.0: Isa 1m 5cm ne1m 20cm padivi nedivi muchikamu chimwe chete, uye utanga wasarudza hurefu hunowira pakati pazvo.
y-m-05-08.s.s2.hint.1: Patsanura zvakare hurefu hwawakasarudza kuita 'm ne cm' uye utarise kuti chikamu che cm hachipfuuri 99.
y-m-05-08.s.s2.ok.c1: m ne cm dzinhamba dzechisikwa dziri marange akarurama.
y-m-05-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Chikamu che cm chinofanira kuva kubva ku0 kusvika ku99. Kana chasvika ku100cm, chinyore se 1m panzvimbo.
y-m-05-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Hachikure kupfuura hurefu hwaSua. Chinja hurefu hwose kuita chikamu chimwe chete uye uzvifananidze.
y-m-05-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Hachipfupi kupfuura 1m 20cm. Chinja hurefu hwose kuita chikamu chimwe chete uye uzvifananidze.
y-m-05-08.s.s2.explain: 1m 5cm i105cm uye 1m 20cm i120cm. Hurefu huri pakati i106cm kusvika ku119cm, saka chero kubva ku1m 6cm kusvika ku1m 19cm kunoshanda. Kana chikamu che cm chasvika ku100 kana kupfuura, unofanira kuchitakura kuenda ku m kana uchinyora.
y-m-05-08.s.s3.prompt: Munin'ina wegiredhi rekutanga akati, "98 yakakura kupfuura 1 kana 5, saka Jiho akareba." Taurira munin'ina wako nemashoko akareruka kuti nei usingafaniri kufananidza saizvozvo, kuti anzwisise.
y-m-05-08.s.s3.hint.0: Funga chinhu chekutaura chinotanga chabvunza kana nhamba dzakafananidzwa nemunin'ina wako dzakanyorwa muchikamu chimwe chete.
y-m-05-08.s.s3.hint.1: Tsanangura nemashoko aanogona kunzwisisa kuti 1m 5cm ireba kuita ma cm mangani.
y-m-05-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakataura nemashoko akareruka kuti m ne cm zvikamu zvakasiyana here?
y-m-05-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakafananidza kukosha kwe 1m 5cm kwakashandurwa kuita cm ne98cm here?
y-m-05-08.s.s3.model.0: 1m i100cm. Saka 1m 5cm i105cm. Kana ukaiisa muchikamu chimwe chete ne98cm, 105 yakakura. Saka Sua akareba.
y-m-05-08.s.s3.model.1: m ne cm zvikamu zvakasiyana, saka haufanire kufananidza nhamba chete. 1m i100cm, saka Sua i105cm uye Jiho i98cm.

y-m-05-04.thinking.0: Kuwana mutsetse wekutanga usina kururama mugadziriso
y-m-05-04.title: Chimiro 가 Chinonzi Chii?
y-m-05-04.goal: Ziva kuti kunyange chimiro chichioneka sesquare, unofanira kuverenga mativi ayo nema vertices kuzvidaidza. Wana gadziriso isina kururama uye uinyore zvakare senote.
y-m-05-04.material: Chimiro 가 chakaita sedzimwe tsamba 'ㄴ'. I square hombe ine square diki yakabviswa kubva pakona imwe. Hangyeol akagadzirisa sezvakaratidzwa pazasi kusarudza zita rechimiro 가.
y-m-05-04.thinking.1: Kuidaidza chimiro nehuwandu hwemativi, kwete nekuoneka kwacho
y-m-05-04.thinking.2: Kugadzirisa gadziriso isina kururama uye kuipfuudza
y-m-05-04.prereq.0: Kunzwa mazita triangle, quadrilateral, pentagon, ne hexagon (Grade 2 level)
y-m-05-04.prereq.1: Kuziva kuti mativi nema vertices i chii
y-m-05-04.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga mugadziriso yaHangyeol apo kufunga kunokanganisa. (Verenga mitsetse kutanga ne nhamba 1.)
y-m-05-04.s.s1.hint.0: Siyanisa kana mutsetse mumwe nemumwe i chokwadi chinobva pakuverenga Figure 가 kana pfungwa inobva pakuoneka kwayo.
y-m-05-04.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kana nhamba yakaverengwa mumutsetse wapfuura ichienderana nezvinotaurwa nemutsetse unotevera.
y-m-05-04.s.s1.line.0: Ndakaverenga mativi e Figure 가 uye ari 6, uye kune ma vertices 6 zvakare.
y-m-05-04.s.s1.line.1: Figure 가 yakaita sesquare hombe ine kona yakabviswa.
y-m-05-04.s.s1.line.2: Yakabva pachimiro che square, saka Figure 가 i quadrilateral.
y-m-05-04.s.s1.line.3: Saka Figure 가 i chimiro chine mativi 4.
y-m-05-04.s.s1.explain: Inotanga kukanganisa mumutsetse 3. Mumutsetse 1 mativi akaverengwa se 6, saka haigone kuva quadrilateral, ine mativi 4. Zvinosarudza zita haisi kwainobva asi kuti ine mativi nema vertices mangani zvino. Mutsetse 4 i mhedziso inopokana nenhamba yakaverengwa mumutsetse 1, saka i kukanganisa kunotevera mutsetse 3.
y-m-05-04.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza zita rakarurama rechimiro 가 nechikonzero chakarurama chekuridaidza kudaro.
y-m-05-04.s.s2.hint.0: Tarisazve mumutsetse 1 kuti Figure 가 ine mativi mangani zvose.
y-m-05-04.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa huwandu hwemativi anotaurwa nesarudzo imwe neimwe ne Figure 가.
y-m-05-04.s.s2.r.a: Iyi i pfungwa yekuti kana nzira yekugadzira yakafanana, zita rakafanana. Verenga kuti zvino kune mativi mangani.
y-m-05-04.s.s2.r.b: Iyi i pfungwa yakasarudza zita nekuverenga huwandu hwemativi nema vertices.
y-m-05-04.s.s2.o.c: Pentagon: Kana ukasiya kona yakabviswa, pane 5.
y-m-05-04.s.s2.r.c: Kufunga uku kwakafungidzira huwandu hwemativi nekubvisa kana kuwedzera nzvimbo yakabviswa. Verenga mitsetse chaiyo rimwe panguva imwe.
y-m-05-04.s.s2.explain: Figure 가 ine mativi 6 ne vertices 6, saka i hexagon.
y-m-05-04.s.s3.prompt: Nyora note kuna Hangyeol. Mudze kuti atarise chii kuti aziwe kana chimiro i quadrilateral.
y-m-05-04.s.s3.hint.0: Enzanisa, uchishandisa Figure 가, kana kuoneka sesquare kwakafanana nekuva quadrilateral.
y-m-05-04.s.s3.hint.1: Mu note, nyora zvose kuti atarise chii uye kuti panofanira kuva nemangani.
y-m-05-04.s.s3.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Hangyeol, kuti uzive kana i quadrilateral, ...
y-m-05-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakavaka note yako panhamba dzakaverengwa, kwete pakuoneka here?
y-m-05-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakashandisa nhamba dzeFigure 가 kutaura nei Figure 가 isiri quadrilateral here?
y-m-05-04.s.s3.model.0: Hangyeol, kunyange chichioneka sesquare, haugone kutaura kuti i quadrilateral. Unofanira kuverenga kana chine mativi 4 ne vertices 4. Figure 가 ine 6, saka haisi quadrilateral.
y-m-05-04.s.s3.model.1: Kuti uzive kana i quadrilateral, verenga kana pane mitsetse mina yakatwasuka (mativi). Figure 가 ine matanhatu, saka haisi quadrilateral asi i hexagon.

y-m-05-02.title: Pane nzira dzingani dzekushandisa tsvimbo dzese?
y-m-05-02.goal: Uchishandisa huwandu hwetsvimbo dzinodikanwa kutriangle nequadrilateral, tsvaga nzira dzakasiyana dzekushandisa tsvimbo dzese 31, uye utsanangure mutemo wekushandura kubva panzira imwe kuenda kune imwe.
y-m-05-02.material: Pane tsvimbo 31 dzine kureba kwakafanana. Unogona kugadzira triangle imwe netsvimbo 3 uye quadrilateral imwe netsvimbo 4. Tsvimbo dzinoshandiswa kuchimiro chimwe dzinoshandiswa kuchimiro icho chete (hapana tsvimbo dzinogoverwa nezvimwe zvimiro). Unoda kushandisa tsvimbo dzese 31 pasina dzasara, uye ugadzire triangle 1 kana kupfuura ne quadrilateral 1 kana kupfuura.
y-m-05-02.thinking.0: Kuwana kuti chimiro chimwe nechimwe chinoda tsvimbo dzingani
y-m-05-02.thinking.1: Kugadzira nzira dzakati wandei dzinogutsa mamiriro
y-m-05-02.thinking.2: Kuwana mutemo wekuchinja nzira imwe kuita imwe
y-m-05-02.prereq.0: Kuziva kuti triangle ine mativi 3 uye quadrilateral ine mativi 4 (Grade 2 level)
y-m-05-02.prereq.1: Kuwedzera nhamba dzine madhijiti maviri, nekuwedzera nhamba imwechete kakawanda
y-m-05-02.s.s1.prompt: Gaon akagadzira ma triangles 6 nema quadrilaterals 3. Gaon akashandisa tsvimbo dzose 31 here?
y-m-05-02.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga waverenga kuti tsvimbo dzingani dzose dzinodiwa ma triangles 6.
y-m-05-02.s.s1.hint.1: Verengawo tsvimbo dzinodiwa ma quadrilaterals 3, wobva wawedzera nhamba mbiri uye uenzanise ne 31.
y-m-05-02.s.s1.r.a: Iyi i pfungwa yakawana huwandu hwetsvimbo hwechimiro chimwe nechimwe, yakadziwedzera, uye yakaenzanisa ne 31.
y-m-05-02.s.s1.r.b: Iyi i pfungwa yakatarisa huwandu hwezvimiro chete, sekuti pane zvimiro 9 zvakagadzirwa zvose, kana yakatonga pasina kutarisa huwandu hwetsvimbo.
y-m-05-02.s.s1.r.c: Iyi i pfungwa yakanganisa kuverenga huwandu hwetsvimbo dzinodiwa ne triangle kana quadrilateral kamwe. Verenga zvakare pachimiro chimwe nechimwe.
y-m-05-02.s.s1.explain: Ma triangles 6 anoda tsvimbo 18 uye ma quadrilaterals 3 anoda tsvimbo 12, saka tsvimbo 30 dzinoshandiswa zvose. Kana tsvimbo 30 pa 31 dzashandiswa, 1 inosara.
y-m-05-02.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira ma triangles t nema quadrilaterals s, uye uwane nzira nhatu dzakasiyana dzekushandisa tsvimbo dzose 31. (t ne s imwe neimwe i natural number ye 1 kana kupfuura.)
y-m-05-02.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza huwandu hwema triangles, wobva wawana kuti tsvimbo dzingani dzasara dzema quadrilaterals.
y-m-05-02.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kuti unogona kugadzira ma quadrilaterals mangani netsvimbo dzasara, uye kana hapana tsvimbo dzasara.
y-m-05-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Pane triangle 1 kana kupfuura uye quadrilateral 1 kana kupfuura.
y-m-05-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Huwandu hwema triangles nema quadrilaterals hunofanira kuva natural number imwe neimwe ye 1 kana kupfuura.
y-m-05-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Tsvimbo dzinosara kana kushaikwa. Wedzera tsvimbo dzinodiwa ma triangles netsvimbo dzinodiwa ma quadrilaterals, uye utarise kana huwandu hwose i 31.
y-m-05-02.s.s2.explain: Izvi zvinogoneka: ma triangles 9 ne quadrilateral 1 (27+4), ma triangles 5 nema quadrilaterals 4 (15+16), triangle 1 nema quadrilaterals 7 (3+28). Kana pane imwe 1 kana kupfuura yega yega, nzira nhatu idzi ndidzo chete.
y-m-05-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Mushure mekuwana nzira imwe, tsanangura kuti ungawana sei nekukurumidza imwe nzira uchishandisa tsvimbo 31 chaizvo.
y-m-05-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Verenga kuti tsvimbo dzingani dzinosara kana ukabvisa mamwe ma triangles kubva panzira yawakawana.
y-m-05-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Tarisa kuti unogona kugadzira ma quadrilaterals mangani akawanda netsvimbo idzodzo.
y-m-05-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisazve kuti nzira itsva inoshandisawo tsvimbo 31 here?
y-m-05-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti huwandu hwema triangles nema quadrilaterals hunochinjanisa sei here?
y-m-05-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Kana ukabvisa ma triangles 4, tsvimbo 12 dzinosara. Unogona kugadzira ma quadrilaterals 3 netsvimbo idzodzo, saka unogona kuchinja ma triangles 4 kuita ma quadrilaterals 3.
y-m-05-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Bvisa ma triangles rimwe panguva imwe uye uverenge kuti unowana ma quadrilaterals mangani kubva patsvimbo. Ma triangles 4 nema quadrilaterals 3 zvose zvinoshandisa tsvimbo 12, saka kuzvichinjanisa kunochengeta huwandu hwose pa 31.
y-m-05-02.s.s2.because.model.2: Kana ukabvisa ma triangles 4 (tsvimbo 12) uye ukashandisa tsvimbo idzodzo kugadzira ma quadrilaterals 3, unoshandisa 31 dzose sezvazviri.

y-m-05-01.title: Kuva nemakona 3 kunoita chimiro kuva triangle here?
y-m-05-01.goal: Funga kuti mamiriro api anodikanwa kuti chimiro chive triangle. Pese paunosangana nechimiro chitsva, tarisa kana pane chinoshaikwa muchirevo chaArin, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako.
y-m-05-01.material: Arin akati, "Chimiro chine makona 3 itriangle." Hapana mifananidzo, saka zvimiro zvinotsanangurwa nemazwi. Rutivi mutsetse unoenda kutenderera chimiro, uye vertex nzvimbo yakapinza apo mativi maviri anosangana.
y-m-05-01.thinking.1: Kutarisa chimiro chitsva uye kugadzirisa kutonga kwako
y-m-05-01.thinking.2: Kurongera kuti mamiriro api anodikanwa nepi asingadikanwi
y-m-05-01.prereq.0: Kuziva kuti mativi (mitsetse inotenderera chimiro) nema vertex (mapoindi apo mativi maviri anosangana) chii (padanho reGiredhi 2)
y-m-05-01.s.s1.prompt: Pese painowedzerwa tsananguro yechimiro chimwe, rongera kufunga kwako pamusoro pechirevo chaArin.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa, rimwe nerimwe, kana zvimiro zvawakaona kusvika zvino zvichipokana nechirevo chaArin.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.hint.1: Mutsananguro itsva, tarisa kuti mativi akaita sei uye kana magumo emativi akabatanidzwa ese.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Chimiro 가 chakagadzirwa nemitsetse 3 yakatwasuka yakabatanidzwa pasina mikaha, ichitenderera. Chinewo ma vertex 3.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Chirevo chaArin chakarurama kuChimiro 가. Asi kuva chakarurama kuchimiro chimwe hazvireve kuti chakarurama kuzvimiro zvese.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Chinogona kuvimbwa. Chimiro 가 itriangle ine ma vertex 3.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kufunga uku kunoona kuti chirevo chakarurama mumuenzaniso mumwe. Kuedza zvimwe zvimiro kwaizochiita chakasimba.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Hatisati tazviziva. Tinofanira kutarisa zvimiro zvakawanda.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kufunga uku kunoona kuti muenzaniso mumwe wakaoma kushandisa kutaura chinhu pamusoro pe "zvimiro zvese."
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Hazvina kururama. Haugoni kuziva triangle nema vertex ayo.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Kufunga uku kunosarudza kuti chirevo chakanganisa kutanga, pasina kutarisa zvimiro.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Chimiro 나 chine ma vertex 3 akapinza. Asi rimwe remativi azvo matatu rinokombama kunze richiita chimiro chakatenderera.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Chimiro 나 chine ma vertex 3 asi haisi triangle. Chirevo chaArin chinoshaya mamiriro okuti "mativi mitsetse yakatwasuka."
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ma vertex anofanira kuverengwa se 4, kwete 3.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kufunga uku kunoshandura nhamba kuti iwirirane nechirevo, kunyange tsananguro ichiti ma vertex ari 3.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Chichiri chakarurama. Chine ma vertex 3, saka itriangle.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kufunga uku kunotarisa nhamba yema vertex chete uye kwete chimiro chemativi.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Chimiro chinogona kuva nema vertex 3 uye kusava triangle.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Kufunga uku kunoona kuti unofanira kutarisa chimiro chemativi, kwete nhamba yema vertex chete.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Chimiro 다 chakagadzirwa nemitsetse 3 yakatwasuka, asi chakatyoka pachikamu chimwe, saka hachitenderere zvachose.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Kana chakatyoka kunyange pachikamu chimwe, hachisi chimiro chinotenderera zvachose. Kunyange nemitsetse 3 yakatwasuka, haisi triangle.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kufunga uku kunotarisawo mamiriro okuti kunyange nemitsetse 3 yakatwasuka, inofanira kukomberedza chimiro.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kufunga uku kunotarisa nhamba nechimiro chemitsetse chete, kwete kana yakabatanidzwa.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Kana mukaha wakatyoka uri mudiki zvikuru, itriangle.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Kufunga uku kunotora mukaha mudiki seunoenzana nekukomberedza. Funga kana chimiro chakatyoka chingadaidzwa kuti chakavharwa.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga, kuva nema vertex 3 kwaiita sekwakakwana. Asi patakasangana nechimiro chine rutivi rwakatenderera nechimiro chakatyoka, takadzidza kuti pane mamiriro akashaikwa. Kuti tiziva kana chirevo chakarurama, tinofanira kutsvaga kwete mienzaniso inowirirana chete asiwo isingawirirani.
y-m-05-01.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza zvese zvinofanira kuva nazvo chimiro kuti chive triangle.
y-m-05-01.s.s2.hint.0: Funga zvakare Zvimiro 가, 나, ne 다, uye uenzanise apo chimiro chaiva triangle neapo chisiri.
y-m-05-01.s.s2.hint.1: Kune zvimiro zvisiri matriangle, tora rimwe nerimwe chakashaikwa.
y-m-05-01.s.s2.o.a: Mativi ese matatu ane kureba kwakafanana.
y-m-05-01.s.s2.r.a: Kufunga uku kwakafungidzira matriangle ane mativi akaenzana chete. Funga kana pane matriangle ane mativi akasiyana mukureba.
y-m-05-01.s.s2.r.b: Kufunga uku kwakatarisa chimiro chemativi samamiriro.
y-m-05-01.s.s2.r.d: Kufunga uku kwakafungidzira matriangle ane kona yesikweya chete. Fungidzirawo triangle ine makona akapinza chete.
y-m-05-01.s.s2.r.e: Kufunga uku kwakatarisa nhamba yemativi samamiriro.
y-m-05-01.s.s2.explain: Triangle chimiro chakakomberedzwa zvose, pasina mikaha, nemitsetse 3 yakatwasuka. Mativi ese kuva akaenzana mukureba kana kuva nekona yesikweya hazvisi mamiriro anodikanwa etriangle.
y-m-05-01.s.s2.acc.0: Mamiriro maviri ekukomberedzwa nemitsetse yakatwasuka akarurama. Mamiriro okuti pane mativi 3 anofanirawo kuvapo kuti chive triangle.

y-m-05-03.title: Pane mablocks mangani kana tichiona kumberi chete?
y-m-05-03.goal: Ziva kuti huwandu hwose hwemablocks hahugone kusarudzwa nekuona kumberi oga, uye uwane iwe pachako ruzivo runoita kuti husarudzwe nenhamba dzinogoneka.
y-m-05-03.material: Mablocks i ma cubes emapuranga ehukuru hwakafanana. Pane nzvimbo 3 padivi pedivi kubva kuruboshwe kuenda kurudyi. Mumutsetse wekumberi, nzvimbo yekuruboshwe ine mablocks 2 (matanho 2), nzvimbo yepakati ine 1, uye nzvimbo yekurudyi ine 1, saka mutsetse wekumberi une mablocks 4 zvose. Kubva kumberi, unoratidzika sematanho, divi rekuruboshwe riri tanho rimwe pamusoro. Pangava nemutsetse wekumashure shure kwemutsetse wekumberi, asi wakavanzwa nemutsetse wekumberi uye hauonekwi. Kana kune mutsetse wekumashure, nzvimbo imwe neimwe yakaturikwa isingapfuure nzvimbo imwechete yemutsetse wekumberi (kana yaiva yakakwirira, waigona kuiona kubva kumberi). Mablocks haafambe mumhepo, uye kune mitsetse miviri chete, wekumberi newekumashure.
y-m-05-03.prereq.1: Kuwedzera nekuenzanisa nhamba dziri padyo ne 10
y-m-05-03.s.s1.prompt: Jihu akati, "Pane mablocks 4 zvose." Neizvo zvatinoziva zvino chete, tingataura izvi nechokwadi here?

y-m-05-03.s.s1.hint.1: Fungidzira mamiriro apo mutsetse wekumashure usina mablocks zvachose nemamiriro apo une mamwe.
y-m-05-03.s.s1.r.a: Kufunga uku kunofungidzira kuti zvaunoona ndizvo zvose. Funga kuti chii chingava munzvimbo dzakavanzwa.
y-m-05-03.s.s1.o.b: Pane 4 kana kupfuura. Hatizive kana kune mutsetse wekumashure.
y-m-05-03.s.s1.r.b: Kufunga uku kunotonga nekupatsanura chikamu chaunoona nechikamu chakavanzwa.
y-m-05-03.s.s1.o.c: Panofanira kuva nemablocks mumutsetse wekumashure, saka pane 5 kana kupfuura.
y-m-05-03.s.s1.r.c: Kufunga uku kunofungidzira kuti panofanira kuva nemablocks munzvimbo yakavanzwa. Funga kana mutsetse wekumashure ungava usina chinhu.
y-m-05-03.s.s1.explain: Mablocks 4 emutsetse wekumberi i chokwadi, asi hatigone kuona kana kune mutsetse wekumashure. Saka tinogona kutaura chete kuti pane 4 kana kupfuura.
y-m-05-03.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza zvidimbu zvose zveruzivo zvekuti kuudzwa chimwe chete chazvo kunokuita kuti usarudze huwandu hwose hwemablocks.
y-m-05-03.s.s2.hint.0: Tarisa kana ruzivo urwu runokuita kuti uzive huwandu hwemablocks emutsetse wekumashure.
y-m-05-03.s.s2.hint.1: Rongera kana runongoratidza chimwe chatoziva, kana harina hukama nenhamba.
y-m-05-03.s.s2.r.a: Kufunga uku kwakasarudza ruzivo rusina hukama nenhamba. Funga kana ruvara rwunokuudza nhamba yakavanzwa.
y-m-05-03.s.s2.o.b: Nzvimbo imwe neimwe yemutsetse wekumashure ine matanho mangani
y-m-05-03.s.s2.r.b: Kufunga uku kunoona kuti hurefu hwenzvimbo imwe neimwe yemutsetse wekumashure hunokuita kuti uwane nhamba yemutsetse wekumashure.
y-m-05-03.s.s2.r.c: Kufunga uku kwakasiya kuona kuti maonero ekudivi anoratidza tanho yakakwirira zvikuru yemutsetse mumwe nemumwe chete. Funga kana inosarudza kuti kune mangani mumutsetse wekumashure.
y-m-05-03.s.s2.r.d: Kufunga uku kunoona kuti kana uchiziva huwandu hwemutsetse wekumashure, unogona kuuwedzera kumutsetse wekumberi kuwana huwandu hwose.
y-m-05-03.s.s2.r.e: Kufunga uku kwakasiya kuona kuti kutarisazve ruzivo rwawatoziva hakusi ruzivo rutsva.
y-m-05-03.s.s2.explain: Mutsetse wekumberi watoziviswa kuti une 4. Kana uchiziva huwandu hwemutsetse wekumashure kana huwandu hwematanho panzvimbo imwe neimwe, huwandu hwose hwakasarudzwa. Ruvara, maonero ekudivi, kana kutarisazve maonero ekumberi hazvigone oga kusarudza huwandu hwemutsetse wekumashure.
y-m-05-03.s.s2.acc.0: Kana uchiziva huwandu hwematanho panzvimbo imwe neimwe yemutsetse wekumashure, unogona kusarudza nhamba. Kuudzwa huwandu hwemutsetse wekumashure zvakananga kunoita basa rimwechete.
y-m-05-03.s.s2.acc.1: Kana uchiziva huwandu hwemutsetse wekumashure, unogona kuusarudza. Kuudzwa huwandu hwematanho panzvimbo imwe neimwe kunoita basa rimwechete.
y-m-05-03.s.s3.prompt: Wana mamiriro matatu apo maonero ekumberi akafanana sepakutanga asi huwandu hwose n hwemablocks hwakasiyana. (Pane mutsetse wekumashure mumwe chete zvakanyanya, uye nzvimbo imwe neimwe yemutsetse wekumashure haipfuuri nzvimbo imwechete yemutsetse wekumberi. Hazvidiwi kuti pave nemutsetse wekumashure.)
y-m-05-03.s.s3.hint.0: Funga mamiriro apo unoisa mablocks mashoma zvikuru mumutsetse wekumashure nemamiriro apo unoisa akawanda zvikuru.
y-m-05-03.s.s3.hint.1: Wana tanho yakakwirira zvikuru yainogona kuva nayo nzvimbo imwe neimwe yenzvimbo nhatu dzemutsetse wekumashure.
y-m-05-03.s.s3.fail.c1: Huwandu hwemablocks hunofanira kuva natural number.
y-m-05-03.s.s3.fail.c2: Mutsetse wekumberi watova ne 4, saka huwandu hwose hahugone kuva shoma kupfuura 4.
y-m-05-03.s.s3.fail.c3: Nzvimbo imwe neimwe yemutsetse wekumashure haigone kuva yakakwirira kupfuura nzvimbo imwechete yemutsetse wekumberi, saka nhamba iyi haigone kugadzirwa.
y-m-05-03.s.s3.explain: Pasina mutsetse wekumashure, pane 4. Kana mutsetse wekumashure une chimiro chakafanana nemutsetse wekumberi (2, 1, 1), pane 4 dzimwe, zvichiita 8. Nhamba ipi neipi kubva ku 4 kusvika ku 8 inogona kugadzirwa.
y-m-05-03.s.s3.because.prompt: Nyora kuti pane mablocks mangani mumamiriro apo unoturika akawanda zvikuru, uye utsanangure nei usingagone kuturika akawanda kupfuura izvozvo.
y-m-05-03.s.s3.because.hint.0: Verenga kuti pane mangani kana ukaturika nzvimbo dzekuruboshwe, dzepakati, nedzekurudyi dzemutsetse wekumashure kuhurefu hwakafanana nemutsetse wekumberi.
y-m-05-03.s.s3.because.hint.1: Fungidzira kuti maonero kubva kumberi aizochinja sei kana ukaturika nzvimbo imwe yemutsetse wekumashure yakakwirira kupfuura mutsetse wekumberi.
y-m-05-03.s.s3.because.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Akawanda zvikuru i mablocks ... Izvi nekuti ...
y-m-05-03.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Wakafunga nezvemamiriro apo nzvimbo dzose nhatu dzemutsetse wekumashure dzakaturikwa dzakakwirira sedzemutsetse wekumberi here?
y-m-05-03.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti kuturika zvakakwirira kwaizochinja maonero kubva kumberi here?
y-m-05-03.s.s3.because.model.0: Kana ukaturika mutsetse wekumashure sewekumberi, 2 kuruboshwe, 1 pakati, ne 1 kurudyi, unowana 4 dzimwe, saka pane 8 zvose. Kana ukaita mutsetse wekumashure wakakwirira, maonero kubva kumberi anochinja.
y-m-05-03.s.s3.because.model.1: Mutsetse wekumberi une 4 uye mutsetse wekumashure unogona kuturikwa kusvika pahurefu hwemutsetse wekumberi chete, saka akawanda zvikuru i 8. Kana ukaturika zvakakwirira kupfuura izvozvo, unogona kuonekwa kubva kumberi zvakare.

y-m-05-05.title: Kucheka kamwe kunogara kuchigadzira triangle here?
y-m-05-05.goal: Ratidza nemuenzaniso mumwe wecounterexample kuti chirevo che "Kana ukacheka square kamwe nemutsetse wakatwasuka, triangle inooneka zvechokwadi" hachina kururama, uye ugadzirise chirevo kuti chive chakarurama.
y-m-05-05.material: Kune bepa rine ruvara rakaita square rine mativi e 6cm. Unobatanidza poinzi P pamudivi wepamusoro nepoinzi Q pamudivi wepasi nemutsetse wakatwasuka uye unocheka. Poinzi P i x cm kurudyi kubva kugumo rekuruboshwe remudivi wepamusoro, uye poinzi Q i y cm kurudyi kubva kugumo rekuruboshwe remudivi wepasi. x ne y i natural numbers kubva ku 0cm kusvika ku 6cm, uye kana i 0cm kana 6cm, poinzi iri pagumo remucheto (vertex). Seoyun akati, "Kana ukacheka square kamwe nemutsetse wakatwasuka, chimwe chezvidimbu chinova triangle zvechokwadi."
y-m-05-05.thinking.0: Kurongera zvinodiwa kuratidza kuti chirevo hachina kururama
y-m-05-05.prereq.0: Kuziva huwandu hwemativi e triangles nema quadrilaterals (Grade 2 level)
y-m-05-05.prereq.1: Kuverenga mamaki pa ruler nekutaura kureba mu cm
y-m-05-05.s.s1.prompt: Unofanira kuratidza chii kutaura kuti chirevo chaSeoyun hachina kururama?
y-m-05-05.s.s1.hint.0: Funga kuti rudzi rwekucheka rupi runofanira kuvapo, kunyange rumwe chete, kuti "zvechokwadi kune" iputswe.
y-m-05-05.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kuti chii chinoitika kuizwi rekuti "zvechokwadi" kana ukaratidza kucheka kwakawanda kunogadzira triangle.
y-m-05-05.s.s1.o.a: Ratidza kucheka kwakasiyana kwakawanda kunogadzira triangle.
y-m-05-05.s.s1.r.a: Kufunga uku kunofungidzira kuti kuunganidza mienzaniso mizhinji inoenderana kunoratidza kuti chirevo hachina kururama. Mienzaniso inoenderana inotsigira chirevo.
y-m-05-05.s.s1.o.b: Edza kucheka kwose kunogoneka, pasina kusiya.
y-m-05-05.s.s1.r.b: Kufunga uku kunoedza mamiriro ose, asi kunyange muenzaniso mumwe usingaenderane wakakwana.
y-m-05-05.s.s1.r.c: Kufunga uku kunoona kuti izwi rekuti "zvechokwadi" rinoputswa nemuenzaniso mumwe usingaenderane.
y-m-05-05.s.s1.explain: Chirevo che "zvechokwadi kune" hachina kururama kana kunyange kucheka kumwe chete kusingagadzire triangle zvachose. Kunyange waunganidza mienzaniso inoenderana yakawanda sei, haugone kuratidza kuti chirevo chinogara chakarurama.
y-m-05-05.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga nzira tatu dzakasiyana dzekucheka zvekuti zvikamu zvose zviri quadrilateral. Sarudza chete x yepoinzi P ne y yepoinzi Q. (x ne y ndema natural number kubva ku0 kusvika ku6.)
y-m-05-05.s.s2.hint.0: Tarisa kuti zvikamu zvinova chimiro chipi kana poinzi P kana poinzi Q iri pamucheto we edge.
y-m-05-05.s.s2.hint.1: Kana mapoinzi P ne Q asiri pamucheto we edge, verenga kuti chikamu chimwe nechimwe chine mativi mangani.
y-m-05-05.s.s2.var.x: Nzvimbo x (cm) yepoinzi P padivi repamusoro
y-m-05-05.s.s2.var.y: Nzvimbo y (cm) yepoinzi Q padivi repasi
y-m-05-05.s.s2.ok.c1: x ne y ndema natural number kubva ku0 kusvika ku6.
y-m-05-05.s.s2.fail.c1: x ne y zvinofanira kuva ma natural number kubva ku0 kusvika ku6.
y-m-05-05.s.s2.ok.c2: Hapana poinzi iri pamucheto we edge, saka zvikamu zvose zviri quadrilateral.
y-m-05-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Nekuti poinzi iri pamucheto we edge, chikamu che triangle chinoonekwa, kana kuti zvakafanana nekusacheka. Edza kufambisa mapoinzi P ne Q kunzvimbo dzisiri pamucheto we edge.
y-m-05-05.s.s2.explain: Kana mapoinzi P ne Q ose asiri pamucheto we edge, zvikamu zvose zviri quadrilateral. Semuenzaniso, (3, 3) ndiyo nyaya yekucheka zvakananga napakati. Kana poinzi iri pamucheto we edge (semuenzaniso, 0 ne6), chikamu che triangle chinoonekwa.
y-m-05-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Sarudza rimwe remacheka awakawana pamusoro uye unyore kuti nei unogona kutaura kuti chirevo chaSeoyun hachina kururama.
y-m-05-05.s.s2.because.hint.0: Kutanga taura mazita ezvikamu zviviri mukucheka kwawakasarudza.
y-m-05-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Funga kuti "zvechokwadi" zvinoreva chii muchirevo chaSeoyun uye uzvienzanise nekucheka kwawakasarudza.
y-m-05-05.s.s2.because.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Kana ukacheka ne P pa ...cm ne Q pa ...cm, ...
y-m-05-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakataura here x ne y (kana nzvimbo) dzekucheka kwawakasarudza?
y-m-05-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakataura here kuti kunyangwe muenzaniso mumwe wakakwana kuratidza kuti "zvechokwadi kuti pane" hazvina kururama?
y-m-05-05.s.s2.because.model.0: Kana ukacheka nekubatanidza P ne Q ose pa 3cm, zvikamu zvose zviri quadrilateral, saka hapana triangle zvachose. Saka chirevo chekuti "zvechokwadi kuti pane" hachina kururama.
y-m-05-05.s.s2.because.model.1: Kana ukabatanidza poinzi ye2cm padivi repamusoro nepoinzi ye4cm padivi repasi, zvikamu zvose zviri quadrilateral ine mativi 4. Hapana triangle inooneka, saka chirevo chaSeoyun hachina kururama.
y-m-05-05.s.s3.prompt: Tinoda kugadzirisa chirevo chaSeoyun kuti chive chakarurama. Sarudza chirevo chakarurama.
y-m-05-05.s.s3.hint.0: Isa padivi pemumwe macheka awakawana kusvika zvino akaita triangle neasina.
y-m-05-05.s.s3.hint.1: Yedza rimwe nerimwe kuti mutsara mumwe nemumwe unosangana nenyaya dzose mbiri here.
y-m-05-05.s.s3.o.a: Kana ukacheka kamwe zvakananga, triangle inogona kuoneka.
y-m-05-05.s.s3.r.a: Kufunga uku kwakagadzirisa chirevo nekusanganisira nyaya apo triangle inooneka neapo isingaoneki.
y-m-05-05.s.s3.o.b: Kana ukacheka kamwe zvakananga, zvikamu zvinogara zviri quadrilateral.
y-m-05-05.s.s3.r.b: Kufunga uku kwakaona mienzaniso ine quadrilateral chete ndokufunga kuti kucheka kwese kwakadaro. Chii chinoitika kana ukacheka pama edge?
y-m-05-05.s.s3.o.c: Kana ukacheka kamwe zvakananga, triangle haimboonekwi.
y-m-05-05.s.s3.r.c: Kufunga uku kwakaona mienzaniso isina triangle chete ndokufunga kuti kucheka kwese kwakadaro. Chii chinoitika kana ukabatanidza edge imwe neimwe?
y-m-05-05.s.s3.explain: Kana ukabatanidza ma edge akatarisana, triangle inooneka, uye kana ukabatanidza nzvimbo dzisiri ma edge, quadrilateral inooneka. Saka "triangle inogona kuoneka" ndicho chirevo chakarurama.

y-m-05-06.title: Dhesiki rakayerwa nemaoko: nderipi rakareba?
y-m-05-06.goal: Nzwisisa kuti hurefu hwakayerwa nevanhu vakasiyana nemaoko avo hahugoni kuenzaniswa nehuwandu hwemaoko chete. Gadzirisa kutonga kwako sezvo ruzivo ruchiwedzerwa, uye gadzira nyaya apo hurefu hwakafanana.
y-m-05-06.material: Gaeun naNarae vakayera divi refu redhesiki imwe neimwe nezvanza zvavo (hurefu kubva pachigunwe kusvika pachigunwe chidiki chakapararira). Zanza romunhu mumwe rinoramba riri hurefu hwakaenzana nguva imwe neimwe. Centimeter (cm) ichikamu chinoratidza hurefu.

y-m-05-06.thinking.1: Kugadzirisa kuvimba sezvo ruzivo rutsva ruchiuya

y-m-05-06.s.s2.explain: Kana zanza raGaeun ri9cm uye raNarae ri12cm, zvose ndi36cm, zvakafanana. 12cm ne16cm (48cm), ne15cm ne20cm (60cm) zvinogonekawo. Pakati pe8cm ne20cm, idzi nhatu ndidzo chete.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.prompt: Nyora kuti nei dhesiki mbiri dzichigona kuva nehurefu hwakafanana kunyangwe huwandu hwezvanza hwakasiyana, 4 ne3.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.hint.0: Sarudza peya imwe yawakawana pamusoro uye uise zanza raGaeun nezanza raNarae padivi pemumwe.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.hint.1: Enzanisa kuti zanza rakaita sei kune akayera kashoma.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakataura here kuti zanza romunhu mumwe rakareba?
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakataura here kuti akayera kashoma anofanira kuva nezanza rakareba kuti hurefu hwakafanana?
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.model.0: Zanza raNarae rakareba kupfuura raGaeun, saka kunyangwe kuyera nguva 3 chete kunogona kupa hurefu hwakafanana nekuyera kwaGaeun nguva 4.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.model.1: Kana zanza raGaeun ri9cm uye zanza raNarae ri12cm, kuwedzera 9 nguva 4 nekuwedzera 12 nguva 3 zvose zvinopa 36cm, zvakafanana. Kana zanza rakakura, kuyera kushoma kunogona kupa hurefu hwakafanana.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.model.2: Hurefu hwezvanza hunosiyana nemunhu, saka kana zanza raNarae rakareba, hurefu hwakafanana hunoda zvanza zvishoma.

y-m-05-07.title: Tingaverenga sei ma triangle ari mu square pasina kusiya?
y-m-05-07.goal: Enzanisa nzira dzekuverenga ma triangle makuru nemadiki mumufananidzo pasina kusiya kana kuverenga kaviri, gadzirisa kuverenga kwakashata, uye gadzira nzira yako yekuverenga kumufananidzo wakasiyana.
y-m-05-07.material: Kutanga kubva kumusoro kuruboshwe uchienda nekutenderera kwewachi, daidza ma vertex mana epepa re square ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ, ne ㄹ. Batanidza ㄱ ku ㄷ ne ㄴ ku ㄹ nemitsetse yakananga, uye mitsetse miviri inosangana papoinzi yepakati ㅁ. Tinoda kuverenga ma triangle ose makuru nemadiki anogona kuwanikwa mumufananidzo uyu. Mativi ose matatu e triangle anofanira kuva pamitsetse yakadhirowa mumufananidzo. (ㄱ inoverengwa giyeok, ㄴ inoverengwa nieun, ㄷ inoverengwa digeut, ㄹ inoverengwa rieul, uye ㅁ inoverengwa mieum.)
y-m-05-07.prereq.0: Kuziva kuti triangle chimiro chakakomberedzwa nemitsetse yakananga 3 (nhanho ye Grade 2)
y-m-05-07.prereq.1: Kuverenga nekuwedzera nhamba dziri padhuze ne10
y-m-05-07.s.s1.prompt: Shamwari ina dzakatsanangura kuti dzinoverenga sei ma triangle. Sarudza nzira dzose dzinogona kuverenga ma triangle ose pasina kusiya kana kuverenga kaviri.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.hint.0: Panzira imwe neimwe, fungidzira kuti ma triangle api angasiiwa.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kuti ma triangle akaverengwa nenzira imwe neimwe anogona kuparadzaniswa pasina kupindirana here.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.o.a: Seojin: Verenga ma triangle madiki zvikuru chete.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.r.a: Kufunga uku hakuverengi ma triangle makuru anoitwa nekubatanidza ma triangle madiki maviri.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.o.b: Daon: Verenga madiki kutanga, wobva waverenga anoitwa nemadiki maviri akabatanidzwa.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.r.b: Kufunga uku kwakaparadzanisa nehukuru uye kwakaverenga nenzira yakarongeka.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.o.c: Hajun: Sarudza mapoinzi 3 pa5 panguva imwe chete, asi siya mapoinzi matatu ari pamutsetse mumwe wakananga.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.r.c: Kufunga uku kunoverenga pasina kusiya nekusarudza mapoinzi, uye kunobvisa nyaya dzisingaiti triangle.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.r.d: Kufunga uku hakuna kurongeka kana mutemo, saka kunogona kusiya dzimwe kana kuverenga dzimwe kaviri.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.explain: Kuverenga nenzira yehukuru, nekusarudza mapoinzi 3 panguva imwe chete uchisiya mapoinzi matatu ari pamutsetse mumwe wakananga, zvose zvinogona kuverenga ma triangle ose. Kuverenga madiki zvikuru chete, kana kuverenga chero chinopinda muziso, kunogona kusiya dzimwe.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.acc.0: Nzira yaDaon inogona kuverenga zvose. Nzira yaHajun inogonawo kuverenga zvose.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.acc.1: Nzira yaHajun inogona kuverenga zvose. Nzira yaDaon inogonawo kuverenga zvose.
y-m-05-07.s.s2.prompt: Minu akasarudza mapoinzi 3 pa5 panguva imwe chete uye akaverenga ma triangle. Sarudza mutsara wekutanga usina kururama. (Verenga mitsara uchitanga nenhamba 1.)
y-m-05-07.s.s2.hint.0: Tarisa rimwe rimwe kuti zvakaverengwa kana zvakasarudzwa mumutsara mumwe nemumwe zvinova triangle chaizvo mumufananidzo here.
y-m-05-07.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kuti nhamba dziri mukuwedzera kwemutsara wekupedzisira dzinoenderana nemitsara yekare here.
y-m-05-07.s.s2.line.0: Ma triangle madiki ndi ㄱㄴㅁ, ㄴㄷㅁ, ㄷㄹㅁ, ne ㄹㄱㅁ, saka pane 4.
y-m-05-07.s.s2.line.1: Ma triangle makuru anoitwa nema triangle madiki maviri akabatanidzwa ndi ㄱㄴㄷ, ㄴㄷㄹ, ㄷㄹㄱ, ne ㄹㄱㄴ, saka pane 4.
y-m-05-07.s.s2.line.2: ㄱㅁㄷ inewo mapoinzi 3 akasarudzwa, saka itriangle.
y-m-05-07.s.s2.explain: Inotanga kukanganisa mumutsara 3. ㄱ, ㅁ, ne ㄷ zviri pamutsetse mumwe wakananga (diagonal), saka hazviite triangle. Nechikonzero chimwe chete ㄴ, ㅁ, ne ㄹ zvinofanirawo kusiiwa, saka pane ma triangle 8 zvose. 9 yemutsara 4 haina kururama nekuti mhedziso inotevera kukanganisa kwemutsara 3.
y-m-05-07.s.s3.prompt: Panguva ino, mu square ㄱ ne ㄷ chete ndizvo zvakabatanidzwa nemutsetse wakananga, uye ㄴ ne ㄹ hazvina kubatanidzwa. Nyora kuti pane ma triangle mangani zvose, uye unyore nzira yawakaverenga nayo pasina kusiya.
y-m-05-07.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora nzira dzose dzekusarudza mapoinzi 3 pa4, uye utarise rimwe rimwe kuti mativi ose matatu emapoinzi matatu awakasarudza akadhirowa here.
y-m-05-07.s.s3.hint.1: Nyaya apo divi raizova mutsetse usina kudhirowa haifaniri kuverengwa se triangle.
y-m-05-07.s.s3.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Pane ma triangle ... Nzira yandakaverenga nayo ndi ...
y-m-05-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa here kuti mativi ose matatu akadhirowa kana wasarudza mapoinzi matatu?
y-m-05-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura here nyaya dzisingagoni kuva triangle nekuti ㄴ ne ㄹ hazvina kubatanidzwa?
y-m-05-07.s.s3.model.0: Pane 2. Ndi ㄱㄴㄷ ne ㄱㄷㄹ. Nzvimbo dzakadhirowa mutsetse chete ndidzo dzinogona kushandiswa semativi, saka pasina ㄴㄹ hapana imwe triangle inogona kugadzirwa.
y-m-05-07.s.s3.model.1: Diagonal ㄱㄷ inoparadzanisa square kuita ma triangle maviri, saka pane 2. Ndakasarudza mapoinzi 3 uye ndikatarisa kuti mativi ose matatu akadhirowa.
